snippet.title: Adepts Arena Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Adepts Arena is a first-person adventure for both flat-screen and VR, featuring advanced physics-based effects. Master the power of the earth element, learn new abilities from ancient spirits, and aid them in their war against the sinister Artificiers' Army!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2268430/Adepts_Arena/
